correctness.rationale: Using published exact equations (5.2),(5.4), prove uniqueness of the u_1=n-k term. Binary carry identity fixes v2 binom(n+d,n)=t_b for all d>=T. For d<T, the bound v2 Lambda<= (r+d)/2 makes r-v2 Lambda>= (B+1)/2 > t_b whenever B>=2t_b. Kummer and Legendre then yield the entire stated valuation formula, and a finite boundary count gives E(c). Code from the packaged files verifies 19,812 recurrence valuations and 18,537 certified positions.

originality.rationale: Adelberg–Lengyel (2021) states almost-full block coverage as a conjecture but proves only half-block coverage; the complete uniform bounded-exception law with E(c) is a strictly stronger conclusion. The prior term-expansion and proof strategy are explicitly credited. Two full primary HTML texts were inspected, and related results/aliases were compared. No equivalent published proof was established by the executed searches, though unindexed implicit coverage remains a risk.
